changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO transactions (account_id, amount, type, transaction_date) SELECT a.id, round((random() * 1000 - 500)::numeric, 4), (ARRAY['TRANSFER_IN','TRANSFER_OUT','DEPOSIT','WITHDRAWAL'])[1 + floor(random() * 4)::int], now() - (g || ' minutes')::interval FROM accounts a CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 50000) AS g WHERE a.account_number = 'John Doe';
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM transactions WHERE account_id IN (SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE account_number = 'John Doe');
